our_interpretation: The firm, testable assertion is that coding accounts for more aggregate cash burn than any other generative-AI use case. The productivity description is qualified by 'possible'; it does not assert a measured productivity gain.
Read 'burning the most cash' as the largest absolute net cash outflow, not the highest token consumption, largest financing round, or worst percentage margin.
Use January–March 2026, the latest completed calendar quarter that could have been reported before the June 7 post. Marcus supplies no reporting period.

Compare cash attributable to each application, including reasonably allocated shared costs. Do not assign all of a multipurpose provider's losses to coding or double-count payments between providers and suppliers.
The surrounding discussion invokes an analyst estimate, so estimate is the closest implied accounting basis. No formal cash-flow definition, currency, or unit is specified.
